name: Two-Stage Unpaired Generative Modelling
aliases: Two-Stage Unpaired Generative Modelling — Shape VAE with CPDDF
definition: A two-stage architecture for 3D-to-2D translation. Stage 1: Shape VAE encoding point clouds to latent shape vector zs using PointNet, decoded by CPDDF. Stage 2: Rendering normals from zs and camera, concatenated with latent texture zT to generate RGB image.
summary: Two-Stage Unpaired Generative Modelling generates photorealistic images from unpaired 3D shape data by decoupling geometry learning via a VAE from texture synthesis using a GAN, distinguishing itself through explicit 3D-aware representation without paired data.
